topic: Compound v2 host checked uint256 intermediates and bounded offline source execution, 2026-09-28

facts.value: Cash plus borrows is checked before reserves subtraction; exchange scaling, accrue products and additions, and underlying conversion check uint256 intermediates before division.
facts.note: CToken exchange lines 265-283, accrual 297-343, underlying 160-163. Current cToken returns early before rate evaluation when the accrual block equals the evaluation block. Solidity 0.8 arithmetic is checked, including intermediate expressions whose final quotient would fit. Source SHA-256 and compiler bindings are in conformance/fixtures/compound-v2-oracle/provenance.txt.

facts.value: The 2019 helpers use checked mulUInt/addUInt/subUInt with error returns; CToken checks rate and cap before its block delta. Failed checked accrual returns a nonzero error and leaves market words unchanged.
facts.note: The model returns Unknown::Invalid for unusable values, not the on-chain ABI error code. The oracle separately checks legacy error codes and state preservation. Backwards-block legacy assert executes INVALID; current underflow panics. WhitePaper ignores reserves and divides its checked annual rate after addition.

facts.value: Both modern and 2020 legacy jump models check utilization numerator/denominator, normal/jump products and additions, supply products, and annual multiplier/kink scaling products before divisions.
facts.note: Legacy jump uses SafeMath and reverts on arithmetic errors, despite returning an error/rate tuple on success. The 2019 WhitePaper returns nonzero checked-math error codes instead. These are exercised as distinct outcomes, never zero-valued success.

facts.value: 2676 calls execute compiled pinned arithmetic and rate functions in controlled harnesses, without chain access or new runtime dependencies.
facts.source_pin: Three Compound commits above; solc 0.8.10, 0.5.8, 0.5.17 official macosx-amd64 binaries from ethereum/solc-bin@16a99b8c26ed33a91796e209ff6797ee7baf2b0d
facts.note: Rust builder extracts complete CToken exchange/accrue function bodies, removes override modifiers and substitutes only the external rate call with controlled scalar/error inputs; source helpers and rate functions are inherited unchanged. This isolates arithmetic and state/error behavior, not deployed getters or the entire EVM. See conformance/fixtures/compound-v2-oracle/README.md for substitutions, counts, hashes and reproduction.

open_questions: No fresh deployed-runtime/activation binding, Ethereum getter capture, initialized-holder evidence, or packaged output qualification is supplied by this offline oracle.
No Compound III/Comet or retained projection support is changed; selected Compound v2 issue acceptance remains separate from arithmetic conformance.
